description: This file declares the VhostDeviceVsock class, which is part of the cuttlefish namespace. The class manages a virtual machine dependency command related to vhost device vsock communication, including methods for command retrieval, enabling status, and waiting for availability. It includes dependencies on various utility and configuration headers.

classes.name: VhostDeviceVsock
classes.description: A class representing a virtual socket device for VMM dependency management within the cuttlefish namespace. It provides methods for command execution, status checks, and dependency management related to vhost device vsock.
